text.text: Cisco Nexus 93128TX switch offers comprehensive layer 2 and layer 3 support and up to 1.28 Tbps of switching capacity in a three-rack-unit from factor. The Nexus 93128TX is ideal for top-of-rack and middle-of-row deployments in both traditional and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) – enabled enterprise, service provider, and cloud environments.

graphic.text: Cisco Nexus 93128TX switch offers comprehensive layer 2 and layer 3 support and up to 1.28 Tbps of switching capacity in a three-rack-unit from factor. text.text: The Cisco Nexus 93128TX has 96 1G/10GBase-T ports and through an uplink module slot, can support 6 or 8 40G QSFP+ ports as well as 4 100GE ports . The switch is ideal as Top-of-Rack (TOR) or Mid-of-Row (MoR) switch architectures. Its flexible architecture and software capabilities enable the creation of a high-performing, programmable, and efficient solution that simplifies migration from 1G to 10G at the server access, can be deployed in 2/3 tier or spine/leaf architectures including Cisco's Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI)
